title: Safe Element Fetch
goal: Safely fetch an item at an arbitrary index without crashing if out of bounds.
hints: Indexing directly with [2] panics when the slice has fewer than three items.
.get(2) returns an Option<&i32>, which needs to be safely converted and unwrapped with a fallback value.
explanation: `items.get(2)` returns an `Option<&i32>`, which avoids panicking on short slices. `.copied()` converts `Option<&i32>` to `Option<i32>`, and `.unwrap_or(0)` safely returns 0 if `None`. Direct indexing `items[2]` panics when the slice length is under 3. Calling `.unwrap()` panics on `None` for short inputs. `.first()` accesses index 0 instead of index 2.
